prompt:
Vertical 9:16 video, 15 seconds, one continuous scene. Clean realistic everyday video, soft natural daylight, shallow depth of field, calm and minimal.
Setting: Sunlit indoor plant care area with wooden table
Action:
[0-5s] Close-up of fingers gently pressing into the potting soil to check moisture. Camera: Static macro angle focusing on soil texture.
[5-10s] Water being poured onto soil and slowly dripping out from the drainage hole at the pot bottom. Camera: Tilt down from soil surface to drainage saucer.
[10-15s] Two hands lifting the drainage saucer and pouring out accumulated water into a sink. Camera: Over-the-shoulder medium shot.
Audio: Rustling of dry soil, gentle sound of pouring water
Constraints: No human faces. No added text overlays, captions or subtitles. No background music. No speech, narration or voice-over.
